verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible headline→CTA→legal flow, but it moves the GLACIER wordmark below the headline. Its can is shrunk so far that the SOLSTICE label is illegible, the headline sits across both background circles, and the two-line legal text is tiny and jammed under the CTA. B has the same tiny can and the brand below the headline, and it also breaks the reading order by moving the 'Find a Store' CTA to the top-left corner, cut off from the headline. Its one-line legal text is unreadably small and runs almost edge to edge.
